$comment: Capability registry for the Freedom Browser Dapp Specification, specVersion 1. Generated from providers/*.md; every capability a host may grant, with its tier, scope schema, the methods it unlocks and its consent-sheet string (SPEC.md §6.1, §12.6). Reserved prefixes carry no capabilities.

reserved.ipfs: a future write surface (pin, add, IPNS); SPEC.md §12.1
reserved.chain: a future public-tier verified-read surface; SPEC.md §12.1
reserved.ethereum: the wallet stays beside the specification; SPEC.md §6.14

capabilities.consentString: Keep files on this device that only this dapp can open
capabilities.methodsNote: On root "private"; files_copy additionally needs the write capability of its destination root.

capabilities.consentString: Read files in your shared folder
capabilities.mandatoryDisclosure: Everything in your shared folder, including which dapp added each file, is visible to every dapp you allow to read it.

capabilities.consentString: Add files to your shared folder
Publish data to Swarm using your postage
capabilities.methodsNote: Also connects the key (swarm_requestAccess, swarm_getUploadStatus, swarm_unsubscribe). Always-allow = autoApprove.publish.

capabilities.consentString: Create and update Swarm feeds signed by an identity for this dapp
capabilities.methodsNote: Shares one feed grant and one app-scoped identity with swarm:signing. Always-allow = autoApprove.feeds.

capabilities.consentString: Sign Swarm chunks with an identity for this dapp

capabilities.methodsNote: Sends prompt per call unless always-allow (autoApprove.messaging); identity and subscribe do not prompt after the grant.

neverAutoApprove: radicle_unseed of a repository the user seeded by hand
capabilities.consentString: Seed and sync Radicle repositories on your node
capabilities.methodsNote: Also connects the key (radicle_getNodeStatus, radicle_listSeededRepos, radicle_getSeedStatus, radicle_disconnect). radicle_sync never prompts. Always-allow = node auto-approve.

capabilities.consentString: Act as you on Radicle: read your identity and write issues and comments in your name
capabilities.mandatoryDisclosure: This dapp will author content as you on the Radicle network. Writes cannot be recalled once announced.
capabilities.methodsNote: Signs with the user's single Radicle node identity. Always-allow = signing auto-approve.

coreMethods.note: dapp_fetch exists on web3:// origins only (SPEC.md §7.14).
